title: Ryan Specialty to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, October 29, 2026
body_markdown:
# Ryan Specialty to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, October 29, 2026


October 01, 2026 4:15pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_651328c2fee68907f3dd63562600e9b0/ryansg/news/2026-10-01_Ryan_Specialty_to_Announce_Third_Quarter_2026_125.pdf)


CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Ryan Specialty Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: RYAN) (“Ryan Specialty”), a leading international specialty insurance firm, today announced it will release its Third Quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Thursday, October 29, 2026.


Ryan Specialty will hold a conference call to discuss the financial results at 4:45pm Eastern Time on October 29, 2026. Interested parties may access the conference call through the live webcast, which can be registered for via this[link](https://ryan-specialty-q3-2026-earnings-call.open-exchange.net/registration) or by visiting the Company’s Investor Relations[website](https://ir.ryanspecialty.com/) . Please join the live webcast at least 10 minutes prior to the scheduled start time.


A webcast replay of the call will be available at[ir.ryanspecialty.com](https://ir.ryanspecialty.com/) for one year following the call.


**About Ryan Specialty**


*Founded in 2010, Ryan Specialty (NYSE: RYAN) is a service provider of specialty products and solutions for insurance brokers, agents, and carriers. Ryan Specialty provides distribution, underwriting, product development, administration, and risk management services by acting as a wholesale broker and a managing underwriter with delegated authority from insurance carriers. Our mission is to provide industry-leading innovative specialty insurance solutions for insurance brokers, agents, and carriers. Learn more at ryanspecialty.com.*
